metadata.title: High-Dimensional Sphere Packing — Kabatiansky-Levenshtein Bound
metadata.title_pt: Empacotamento Esférico em Alta Dimensão — Cota de Kabatiansky-Levenshtein
metadata.summary: Asymptotic exponential upper bound on spherical codes and kissing numbers in R^n.
metadata.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Kabatiansky-Levenshtein theorem proves for high-dimensional unit spheres.
metadata.teacher_reference: The Kabatiansky-Levenshtein theorem provides an upper bound on the number of non-overlapping unit spheres that can be packed into a high-dimensional space, specifically showing that the maximum number of such spheres grows exponentially with the dimension but at a rate slower

metadata.title: Thermodynamics of Computation — Landauer's Principle (k_B T ln 2)
metadata.title_pt: Termodinâmica da Computação — Princípio de Landauer (k_B T ln 2)
metadata.summary: Minimum irreversible heat dissipation bound k_B T ln 2 per erased bit at temperature T.
metadata.example_prompt: Explain concisely what Landauer's principle states for the minimum energy dissipated when erasing one bit at temperature T.
metadata.teacher_reference: Landauer's principle states that the minimum energy dissipated when erasing one bit of information at temperature \( T \) is \( k_B T \ln 2 \), where \( k_B \) is the Boltzmann constant.

metadata.title: Space Complexity — Immerman-Szelepcsényi Theorem (NSPACE = co-NSPACE)
metadata.title_pt: Complexidade Espacial — Teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi (NSPACE = co-NSPACE)
metadata.summary: Closure of nondeterministic space complexity classes under complementation via inductive counting.
metadata.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Immerman-Szelepcsenyi theorem proves about nondeterministic space complexity classes.
metadata.teacher_reference: The Immerman-Szelepcsenyi theorem proves that nondeterministic space complexity classes are closed under complementation, specifically that NSPACE(s(n)) = co-NSPACE(s(n)) for any function s(n) ≥ log(n).

metadata.title: Distributed Consensus — FLP Impossibility Theorem
metadata.title_pt: Sistemas Distribuídos — Teorema da Impossibilidade FLP
metadata.summary: Impossibility of deterministic fault-tolerant consensus in asynchronous message-passing systems with one crash.
metadata.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Fischer-Lynch-Paterson impossibility theorem proves about asynchronous consensus.
metadata.teacher_reference: The Fischer-Lynch-Paterson (FLP) impossibility theorem proves that in an asynchronous distributed system, it is impossible to achieve deterministic consensus if even a single process may fail.

metadata.title: Algorithmic Information Theory — Chaitin's Incompleteness Theorem
metadata.title_pt: Teoria Algorítmica da Informação — Incompletude de Chaitin (Kolmogorov)
metadata.summary: Upper bound L beyond which no formal axiomatic system can prove lower bounds K(x) > L on Kolmogorov complexity.
metadata.example_prompt: Explain concisely what Chaitin's incompleteness theorem proves regarding Kolmogorov complexity.
metadata.teacher_reference: Chaitin's incompleteness theorem proves that within any consistent formal axiomatic system, there is a constant L such that the system cannot prove the Kolmogorov complexity of any string exceeds L.

metadata.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography — Regev's LWE Worst-Case Lattice Reduction
metadata.title_pt: Criptografia Pós-Quântica — Redução Quântica LWE de Regev
metadata.summary: Quantum worst-case to average-case reduction from GapSVP/SIVP lattice problems to Learning With Errors (LWE).
metadata.example_prompt: Explain concisely what Oded Regev's theorem proves connecting Learning With Errors (LWE) to worst-case lattice problems.
metadata.teacher_reference: Oded Regev proved that the hardness of the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem in its average case is at least as hard as certain worst-case lattice problems, specifically the shortest vector problem (SVP) and the closest vector problem (CVP).

metadata.title: Random Matrix Theory — Marchenko-Pastur Spectral Distribution
metadata.title_pt: Matrizes Aleatórias em IA — Lei Espectral de Marchenko-Pastur
metadata.summary: Limiting eigenvalue density and compact support [(1 - sqrt(gamma))^2, (1 + sqrt(gamma))^2] of Wishart covariance matrices.
metadata.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Marchenko-Pastur law establishes for the eigenvalues of large random covariance matrices.
metadata.teacher_reference: The Marchenko-Pastur law states that the limiting eigenvalue distribution of large random sample covariance matrices, as the dimensions grow proportionally, follows a specific distribution characterized by a continuous density function and a possible atom at the origin.

metadata.title: Communications & Signal Theory — Shannon-Hartley Channel Capacity
metadata.title_pt: Engenharia de Comunicações — Lei de Capacidade de Shannon-Hartley
metadata.summary: Tight upper rate C = B log2(1 + S/N) for arbitrarily reliable communication over an AWGN channel.
metadata.example_prompt: State concisely the Shannon-Hartley channel capacity formula and what it proves for noisy AWGN channels.
metadata.teacher_reference: The Shannon-Hartley theorem establishes that the maximum error-free information capacity \( C \) over a noisy Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel is given by \( C = B \log_2(1 + \frac{S}{N}) \)

metadata.example_prompt: State Landauer's thermodynamic bound for erasing a bit at temperature T and connect it to the Immerman-Szelepcsenyi closure property of nondeterministic space classes.
metadata.teacher_reference: Landauer's principle, stating that erasing one bit of information at temperature T requires at least kT ln 2 energy, is fundamentally about the thermodynamic cost of computation, whereas the Immerman-Szelepcsenyi theorem proves that nondeterministic space

metadata.title: Thermodynamics of Computation — Landauer's Principle (PT-BR)
metadata.title_pt: Física da Informação — Princípio de Landauer (k_B T ln 2) (PT-BR)
metadata.summary: Dissipação térmica mínima k_B T ln 2 por bit apagado irreversivelmente à temperatura T.
metadata.example_prompt: Me fale sobre o princípio de Landauer e a energia mínima dissipada na temperatura T.
metadata.teacher_reference: O princípio de Landauer afirma que apagar irreversivelmente 1 bit à temperatura absoluta T dissipa no mínimo E_min = k_B T ln 2 de calor, onde k_B = 1,380649e-23 J/K é a constante de Boltzmann.

metadata.title: Statistical Mechanics — Boltzmann Constant k_B = 1.380649e-23 J/K (PT-BR)
metadata.title_pt: Mecânica Estatística — Constante de Boltzmann (k_B = 1,380649e-23 J/K) (PT-BR)
metadata.summary: Definição SI exata k_B = 1,380649e-23 J/K, entropia de Boltzmann S = k_B ln Omega e aplicações em termodinâmica.
metadata.example_prompt: O que é a constante de Boltzmann e onde ela se aplica?
metadata.teacher_reference: A constante de Boltzmann (símbolo k_B) vale exatamente 1,380649e-23 J/K no SI, convertendo temperatura absoluta em energia térmica na entropia S = k_B ln(Omega), gases ideais (PV = N k_B T) e semicondutores.

metadata.title: System One Architecture — Mixture of Scars (MoS) & SCache O(1) (PT-BR)
metadata.title_pt: Arquitetura Proprietária — Mixture of Scars (MoS) + SCache O(1) + HTTP 206
metadata.summary: Pesos Block-64 INT4 + cicatrizes ASVD, memória associativa SCache O(1) via regra de Widrow-Hoff e cartuchos HTTP 206.
metadata.example_prompt: Qual arquitetura você usa? Detalhe o Mixture of Scars e o SCache O(1).
metadata.teacher_reference: Eu sou o assistente System One e rodo na arquitetura proprietária Mixture of Scars (MoS Block-64 INT4 + cicatrizes ASVD), memória associativa constante SCache O(1) e cartuchos ScarStore sob demanda via HTTP 206.

metadata.title: Distributed Systems — FLP Impossibility Theorem (PT-BR)
metadata.title_pt: Sistemas Distribuídos — Teorema da Impossibilidade FLP (PT-BR)
metadata.summary: Impossibilidade de consenso determinístico tolerante a 1 falha por parada em redes assíncronas.
metadata.example_prompt: Explique o teorema da impossibilidade FLP (Fischer-Lynch-Paterson) em sistemas distribuídos assíncronos.
metadata.teacher_reference: O teorema FLP (Fischer-Lynch-Paterson) prova que em uma rede assíncrona nenhum protocolo determinístico de consenso garante simultaneamente segurança e terminação se apenas 1 processo puder sofrer falha por parada (crash).

metadata.title: Space Complexity — Immerman-Szelepcsényi Theorem (PT-BR)
metadata.title_pt: Complexidade Espacial — Teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi (PT-BR)
metadata.summary: Fechamento das classes NSPACE(s(n)) sob complementation (NSPACE = co-NSPACE) para s(n) >= log n.
metadata.example_prompt: O que prova o teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi sobre classes de complexidade espacial não-determinística?
metadata.teacher_reference: O teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi prova, por contagem indutiva, que toda classe espacial não-determinística com s(n) >= log(n) é fechada sob complementação: NSPACE(s(n)) = co-NSPACE(s(n)).

metadata.title: Random Matrix Theory — Marchenko-Pastur Spectral Law (PT-BR)
metadata.title_pt: Matrizes Aleatórias — Lei Espectral de Marchenko-Pastur (PT-BR)
metadata.summary: Distribuição limite dos autovalores de matrizes de covariância amostral no suporte [sigma^2(1 - sqrt(gamma))^2, sigma^2(1 + sqrt(gamma))^2].
metadata.example_prompt: O que estabelece a lei espectral de Marchenko-Pastur para matrizes aleatórias de covariância?
metadata.teacher_reference: A lei de Marchenko-Pastur descreve a distribuição limite dos autovalores de matrizes de covariância (1/n) X X^T quando p/n -> gamma, concentrada no suporte compacto [sigma^2(1 - sqrt(gamma))^2, sigma^2(1 + sqrt(gamma))^2].

metadata.title: Brazilian Labor Law — Domestic Workers & Cleaners (LC 150/2015)
metadata.title_pt: Direito do Trabalho — Empregadas Domésticas e Diaristas (LC 150/2015 — PEC das Domésticas)
metadata.summary: Distinção legal entre vínculo doméstico (>2 dias/semana, LC 150/2015: CTPS, FGTS, INSS, 44h) e diarista autônoma (até 2 dias/semana).
metadata.example_prompt: Como funciona o direito trabalhista para faxineiras no Brasil segundo a LC 150/2015?
metadata.teacher_reference: O direito trabalhista para faxineiras no Brasil segue a LC 150/2015: mais de 2 dias por semana na mesma residência gera vínculo doméstico (CTPS, FGTS, INSS, férias e 13º); até 2 dias por semana caracteriza diarista autônoma sem vínculo.
